name: experience-architecture
description: Find out why a web app's navigation, pages, links or Back button feel wrong, decide whether its structure should change, and prove it in a real browser. Diagnose, Rethink and Verify over a zero-dependency toolkit for route maps, browser journeys, prototypes and URL migrations, plus Walkthrough (preview), which learns the product by using it and says how big a change it needs. Strongest on React and Next.js.
